studies.notes: Read the complete c015 markdown conversion, including the appended Reporting Summary, and the complete supplement conversion; checked every page of both PDFs. S3 is the reanalysis of Lee and Chung Experiment 2B. The main extracted analysis is the percentage of unique idea concepts at the main overlap threshold, comparing ChatGPT–human with Human-only. Supplementary Table 1 prints the two eligible arm counts but no separate total of people; the table-wide total includes the model-only pool. No arm counts were added, no model-only outputs were subtracted, and no people count was inferred from degrees of freedom. The supplementary threshold and similarity analyses use the same printed arm counts; no different eligible analyzed-person counts are reported. Neither c015 nor its supplement prints randomized or enrolled totals or per-arm randomized counts. The c015 Reporting Summary, PDF p. 5, describes the study as "Secondary analysis of previously published data by Lee & Chung (2024)" and marks research sample, exclusions, and randomization N/A; this does not establish zero exclusions. Also read the complete original c010 markdown conversion and checked its Experiment 2B Results, Methods, and Reporting Summary against the PDF. The original-paper participant and survey-flow counts are explicitly labeled as contextual in other_counts and are not substituted for unprinted c015 totals. Original c010 Methods, PDF p. 7 (printed p. 1912), says collection stopped after responses met the attention-check and sensical-response criteria; the discrepancy between its analyzed sample and survey finishers was not converted into an inferred exclusion count. Quotes preserve the PDF text, including line breaks and characters; the extraction arm names are unchanged.
